product.name: Productized Services
product.description: A platform feature that enables agencies to offer predefined, subscription-based services to clients, facilitating recurring revenue and streamlined service delivery.

product.name: Feedback Tools
product.description: A set of tools that allow agencies and clients to review, comment on, and manage feedback on various file types including images, videos, PDFs, and live websites.

product.name: Client Portal
product.description: A client-facing interface that allows clients to submit requests, track project progress, and communicate directly with the agency within a secure environment.

product.name: Project Management Features
product.description: Tools within Queue that help agencies organize, assign, and track tasks and projects, including task boards, sub-tasks, and automated task assignment.

product.name: Time Tracking Software
product.description: A feature that allows agencies to monitor and record the time spent on tasks and projects for billing and productivity analysis.

product.name: Client Onboarding
product.description: A software tool that facilitates the onboarding process for new clients by collecting necessary information through customizable checklists and forms.
